slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Very Hard · Binary Trees
slides.narration: Let's solve All Kinds Of Node Depths, a very hard binary trees problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: Sum, over every node, of the depths of all nodes in its subtree (relative to it).
Per subtree: sumDepths = sumDepths(l) + size(l) + sumDepths(r) + size(r).
